I'm weighing a 0.3 mm per side interference on the PLA ribs, which is tight but should still crush. Printed holes tend to come out a bit undersized, so the 0.25 mm pocket clearance might tighten too. A 0.6 mm radius rib with a 0.4 mm nozzle is very small, so I'm considering making it smaller, closer to the usual 0.2-0.3 mm per side.

I'm dropping the rib default to 0.2 per side, which gives 7.6 across the ribs, and testing a 0.1/0.2/0.3 per-side coupon. I also want the rib-to-rib distance spelled out in the notes and a clearer manual that asks for the results back.

def build(p):
    D=p.knob_d; H=p.knob_h
    k=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(D/2).extrude(H)

    for i in range(int(p.scallop_n)):
        a=2*math.pi*i/p.scallop_n
        rr=D/2+p.scallop_r*0.45
        s=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-1).center(rr*math.cos(a),rr*math.sin(a)).circle(p.scallop_r).extrude(H+2)
        k=k.cut(s)
    k=k.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-1).circle(p.bolt_clear_d/2).extrude(H+2))
    depth=p.nut_h+p.pocket_extra_depth

    hexp=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=H-depth).polygon(6,afc/math.cos(math.pi/6)).extrude(depth+1)
    k=k.cut(hexp)
    c=p.nut_af/2-p.rib_interf+p.rib_r
    for deg in (30,150,270):
        a=math.radians(deg)
        rib=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=H-depth).center(c*math.cos(a),c*math.sin(a)).circle(p.rib_r).extrude(depth-p.rib_lead)
        k=k.union(rib)
